story_type: four boaters sitting on a capsized hull far offshore, swimmer and basket hoist
hook: Their boat flipped 35 miles out. Four of them sat on the hull.
narration: Their boat flipped thirty-five miles out in the Gulf, and four people climbed onto the hull.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Clearwater found them.
The crew lowered a rescue swimmer down the cable to the water beside them.
Staying with the boat was the right call. A hull is far easier to spot from the air than a head in the water.
outcome: Then the Clearwater crew rescued all four of them from the water off Homosassa.
title: Boat flipped 35 miles out, 4 on the hull
description:
On March 30, 2019, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew found four boaters on the hull of their capsized boat 35 miles west of Homosassa, Florida, and rescued all four from the water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Clearwater, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/668967
